description: Tabs: op=list / new / close / switch. switch makes a tab the default target for later calls, so you rarely pass tab explicitly.

op.description: list = id/url/title/active for every tab. switch = make `tab` the default target.

tab.description: close / switch: the target tab id.

url.description: new: open at this URL (default about:blank).

name: browse_tabs
title: Tabs
